title: Climate change may help eliminate malaria from West and Central Africa | New Scientist
description: Global warming may make it too hot for malaria-carrying mosquitoes to survive in parts of Africa, but could also shift the problem to less affected areas
author: Christa Lesté-Lasserre

title: High-protein is a wellness craze, but could restricting it be anti-ageing? | New Scientist
description: Protein is everywhere, but studies – mostly in non-human animals – suggest that limiting our intake could extend our lifespan
author: Carissa Wong

title: Thousands of people in China have had banned Alzheimer's surgery | New Scientist
description: Surgery that aims to enhance the clearance of Alzheimer's-associated proteins from the brain has been banned in China, but only after thousands of people had the procedure
author: Carissa Wong

title: Where to watch the next total solar eclipse anywhere in the world | New Scientist
description: The total solar eclipse on 12 August will only be visible to a lucky few, but eclipses happen all over the world – here are the next ones to look out for, wherever you may be
author: Leah Crane

title: Smallpox DNA in ancient Inca mummies shows virus came from Europe | New Scientist
description: The mummies of two people who lived in Chile more than 400 years ago carry DNA from smallpox, providing the first molecular evidence that the virus was brought to the Americas from Europe
author: James Woodford

title: The genome of a long-extinct ancient human is hiding within us | New Scientist
description: We all have bits of DNA from a long-lost “ghost ancestor” inside us – and by putting all the different bits together, we might be able to reconstruct their genome
author: Michael Le Page
